description: The pinned GLSL-to-SPIR-V compiler (RFC 0016 K0, check shader.toolchain-pin). Every committed SPIR-V module in the tree is built with this compiler and must rebuild byte-identically with it; a compiler reporting any other identity fails the check. tools/render/shader_toolchain.py is the single owner of the pin logic: 'build' makes dependencies/shader-toolchain (gitignored) from the pinned archives below, 'check' verifies the compiler identity and rebuilds every committed module, and the regenerators (materialsystem/shaderapivulkan/shaders/regen_*.py) locate the compiler through it. Host compiler facts for the tree's C++ stay in policy.json; this file owns only the shader compiler.

compiler.identity_note: glslc --version prints its build-version.inc and then its default target. Upstream derives each line from 'git describe' of the project checkout; a source archive has no git history, so the builder writes the lines a checkout of the pinned tags reports (patches, below).

debug_compiler.note: Only regen_material_spv.py --debug-out uses it (source-level debug variants for RenderDoc); none of its output is committed. It is glslang's standalone compiler from the same pinned glslang, installed under its legacy name.

component_note: The set is shaderc v2026.1's own DEPS (glslang_revision, spirv_tools_revision, spirv_headers_revision); SPIRV-Tools v2026.1's DEPS names the same SPIRV-Headers commit. Tags resolved through the GitHub API on 2026-09-26: shaderc v2026.1 -> 301b4ede, glslang 16.2.0 -> f0bd0257, SPIRV-Tools v2026.1 -> fbe4f3ad. The sha256 of each commit archive is the pin.

patches.shaderc/utils/update_build_version.py: Replaced by the builder with a script that writes compiler.identity's component lines. Upstream runs 'git describe' in each source directory; in an archive that falls back to 'unknown hash, <today>', or, inside this repository's worktree, describes the engine's own commit.

host_requirements: a C++17 host compiler (the system c++)

other_builds_observed.note: Not accepted: a different build (distribution SPIRV-Headers snapshot and flags) with a different identity, so the check rejects it. Its 'glslang 301b4ede...' is the Fedora spec's name for the shaderc archive commit, not a glslang commit. The committed modules predate the pin and were built with distribution compilers like this one; the pinned build reproduces every one byte-identically (2026-09-26), so no committed module changed when the pin was introduced (two unreferenced, stale arrays in demo_triangle_spv.h were deleted).

cross_compiler.description: SPIRV-Cross, the pinned SPIR-V cross-compiler and reflector (RFC 0016 K4, check render.shader-artifacts). tools/render/shader_artifacts.py turns each pinned-glslc SPIR-V module into its GLSL 4.50 artifact and reads its bindings with --reflect. A host tool: no product links it. It has its own build stamp (dependencies/shader-toolchain/manifest-spirv-cross.json), so adding it did not rebuild glslc.
cross_compiler.identity_note: spirv-cross --revision prints (to stderr) the 'git describe' and the time CMake configured it; an archive has no history and the time changes per build, so the builder writes the tag and the word 'pinned' (patches, below).
cross_compiler.component_note: The newest SPIRV-Cross tag when pinned; resolved through the GitHub API on 2026-09-28 (vulkan-sdk-1.4.357.0 -> 6c09849f). SPIRV-Cross carries its own SPIR-V headers, so it needs none of the glslc components.

patches.cmake/gitversion.in.h: Replaced by the builder with the identity line above. Upstream fills in 'git describe' and the configure time.
